about: Cases for a type with a fixed set of documents (Barkpark's schema key fixedDocuments, api/lib/barkpark/content/fixed_documents.ex). 'server' per case is Barkpark's answer (FixedDocuments.answer/4) for that write on a type whose list is 'fixed' (null: no list); a duplicate is a create of a new id, an edit a write over a row that exists. app/src/lib/fixed-documents-server.test.ts checks the studio never offers a write Barkpark refuses (lib/fixed-documents.ts), and hides one Barkpark allows only where 'gap' names the task for it. Regenerate: elixir scripts/fixed-document-cases.exs <barkpark checkout>. G5 (task-f4c80d82cc25b19b).
